title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes; v1.89.0
author: Avery Chen

description:
Motivation: Users reported inconsistent retry/backoff semantics and differing streaming ergonomics between Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs (ENG-4821). This PR unifies auth token refresh handling, standardizes retry/backoff configuration, and improves streaming ergonomics across all three SDKs to reduce surprises for multi-language teams.

What this PR does: 
- Python: centralize auth token refresh, add RetryConfig object, make streaming expose async iterator and optional callback pattern for easier consumption.
- TypeScript: align default retry/backoff values with other SDKs, add typed RetryOptions and streaming iterator helper.
- Go: expose RetryPolicy, fix reconnect edge case in stream client, and export ergonomics-friendly helpers.
- Tests: add cross-sdk parity tests (wiremock + local runtime harness) covering token expiry, transient 5xx, and stream reconnects.
- Docs: migration guide and changelog for v1.89.0.

Checklist:
- [x] Unify retry/backoff defaults and config names across SDKs
- [x] Implement python async iterator + callback streaming ergonomics
- [x] Expose typed Retry structs/objects in TS and Go
- [x] Add parity tests and CI coverage
- [x] Update docs and changelog

Notes: No breaking API changes were introduced; all previously-public constructors remain available. Minor ergonomics additions are additive (new helper types and convenience overloads). Related: ENG-4870 (streaming reliability), ENG-4902 (sdk ergonomics).
review_conversation:
Diego: flagged a potential race in python token refresh under concurrent requests; asked for a small lock around refresh. Author: implemented lightweight lock using asyncio.Lock in python auth module and added test.
Priya: requested clearer naming for RetryConfig fields in TS; author renamed retry.window -> retry.jitter_window and added inline comments.
Liam: ran the go client in internal staging and reported a reconnect off-by-one; author fixed and added a regression test.
All reviewers approved after two rounds of fixes. CI reran flaky streaming tests twice and passed.
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth token refresh and retry/backoff defaults across Python/TypeScript/Go; improved streaming ergonomics (python async iterator + callbacks, TS helpers, Go reconnect fixes); parity tests added; bumped SDK version to v1.89.0.
